# Führerschein Theorie (Klasse B) — Full Reference

Base URL: https://fuehrerschein.pages.dev/
Russian Mirror Prefix: https://fuehrerschein.pages.dev/ru/
English Expat Guide: https://fuehrerschein.pages.dev/en/

## 1. Product Summary

Führerschein Theorie (Klasse B) is a 100% free, ad-free web application and installable PWA for preparing for the German theoretical driving exam (Klasse B).
- Languages in trainer: German (`de`) and Russian (`ru`), with an inline "Original (DE)" peek button on Russian questions.
- No mandatory account or paywall; progress is stored in `localStorage` with optional username/password cloud sync.
- Question catalog: 1316 unique Klasse B questions (filtered from amtlicher Fragenkatalog to Klasse B/BE + Grundstoff).

## 4. Official TÜV / DEKRA Exam Rules (Klasse B)

- Questions per exam: 30 (20 Grundstoff + 10 Zusatzstoff Klasse B).
- Point values: 2, 3, 4, or 5 fault points (Fehlerpunkte) per question.
- Passing rule: maximum 10 fault points total, AND no more than one 5-point question answered incorrectly (two wrong 5-point questions = automatic fail even if total ≤10).

## 5. Official Formulas (`formulas.html`)

- **Reaktionsweg (m):** `(Speed / 10) × 3`
- **Bremsweg normal (m):** `(Speed / 10) × (Speed / 10)`
- **Bremsweg Gefahrenbremsung / emergency (m):** `((Speed / 10) × (Speed / 10)) / 2`
- **Anhalteweg (m):** `Reaktionsweg + Bremsweg`
- Example at 50 km/h: Reaction = 15 m, Normal Braking = 25 m, Total Stopping = 40 m (Emergency = 27.5 m).
- Example at 100 km/h: Reaction = 30 m, Normal Braking = 100 m, Total Stopping = 130 m (Emergency = 80 m).
- Minimum tire tread depth: `1.6 mm`.
- Overtaking lateral distance to cyclists/pedestrians: `1.5 m` inside built-up areas (`innerorts`), `2.0 m` outside (`außerorts`).
- Fog visibility `< 50 m`: max speed `50 km/h`, rear fog light (`Nebelschlussleuchte`) permitted.

## 6. Official Exam Languages (Anlage 7 FeV)

- Currently available at TÜV/DEKRA PC terminals: German plus 12 foreign languages — English, French, Greek, Italian, Croatian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Standard Arabic (`Hocharabisch`).
- Ukrainian & Kurmandschi: legally added to Anlage 7 FeV with terminal rollout scheduled for April 1, 2027 (§ 76a FeV). Note: valid Ukrainian driving licenses can often be exchanged under Anlage 11 FeV without exams.
- Personal interpreters are not permitted at the PC theory test (since 2011; exception for deaf candidates with sign-language interpreters).

## 7. Foreign License Conversion (`Umschreibung`, § 31 FeV)

- Foreign licenses remain valid for 6 months after establishing residence (`Wohnsitz`) in Germany.
- For third-country licenses requiring theory/practical exams, § 31 FeV waives mandatory theory classroom hours (`Pflichtstunden`) and mandatory special driving lessons (`Sonderfahrten`).
- Formal registration at a `Fahrschule` is still required so the school can submit the exam order to TÜV/DEKRA, alongside `Sehtest`, `Erste-Hilfe-Kurs`, biometric photo, and certified license translation.
